description: Displayed wearing the serial 115 which is also the serial of the AH-1G at the Israeli Air Force Museum. The true airframe is not established so tail_number is left blank.

One of the three F-4E(S) long-range oblique photography Phantoms. Spottingmode gives construction number 4023 for this airframe and the same construction number for 498 at the Israeli Air Force Museum; the two cannot both be right and the construction number is therefore not carried here.
Displayed wearing the serial 010 and possibly the former 747; neither reading is confirmed so tail_number is left blank.
